page.title: Checkout
page.description: Review your cart and enter the details needed to place your order.

flow.hydrationFailed: We cannot refresh your cart right now. Please try again.
flow.emptyDescription: Add a product before continuing to checkout.
flow.cartUpdated: Your cart was updated because one or more products are no longer available for ordering.
flow.storageUnavailable: Checkout state cannot be saved in this browser.

review.title: Order review
review.advisory: Displayed prices include VAT and are advisory. Products, availability, promotions, VAT and totals are checked again when you place the order.

form.title: Customer and delivery details
form.description: All required fields are used to review and confirm your order.
form.name: Name
form.pendingConfirmation: No online payment is taken. After you place the order, it remains pending until our team contacts you and confirms it.

errors.name: Enter a valid name between 2 and 100 characters.
errors.privacyAcknowledged: Confirm that you have read the privacy information.
errors.cartStale: Your cart changed before the order could be placed. Review the updated cart and try again.
errors.possibleDuplicate: This order may already have been received. Do not place it again; contact us if you need help.
errors.temporaryFailure: The order could not be placed right now. Your details and cart are preserved; please try again.

confirmation.title: Order received
confirmation.description: Your order has been recorded and is pending confirmation.
confirmation.pending: This order is pending confirmation by our team. We will contact you to confirm it.
confirmation.unavailableDescription: This confirmation has expired or is not available in this browser. No new order has been created.
